rationale: Correct the ReadIndex membership-filter entry. Re-reading the broadcast path shows votingMembers() is the union of remotes and witnesses, so witnesses are addressed by the hint-carrying heartbeat and their acknowledgements count in the same quorums as voters. The previous statement wrongly said witnesses are not addressed and treated the send-side filter as excluding them. The corrected account keeps the measured and source-supported part: observers receive a heartbeat only with a zero context, so they cannot echo a nonzero hint, and a sender absent from every role map is dropped by the lw admission lookup before readIndex.confirm runs, which is why the removed-voter and unknown-sender responses produced no confirmation.

knowledge.statement: When a ReadIndex request is pending, broadcastHeartbeatMessage uses readIndex.peepCtx as the heartbeat context and broadcastHeartbeatMessageWithHint sends that hint-carrying heartbeat to every member of votingMembers(), which is the union of remotes and witnesses; observers are sent a heartbeat only when the context is zero. numVotingMembers() is len(remotes)+len(witnesses), and both quorum() and the commit path use it, so a witness acknowledgement counts toward the read quorum and the commit quorum alike. On the leader, a HeartbeatResp is admitted through lw, which resolves the sender against the current remotes, observers and witnesses maps and drops the message when it is in none of them; handleLeaderHeartbeatResp then passes a nonzero hint to handleReadIndexLeaderConfirmation, and readIndex.confirm performs no further role check.
knowledge.conditions: The node is leader with at least one pending ReadIndex request, the role maps reflect the current configuration, and a heartbeat response arrives from a node that is currently a voter, an observer, a witness, or in no role map.
knowledge.changed_premise: The earlier statement said witnesses are not addressed by the hint-carrying heartbeat and that the send-side filter excluded them from the acknowledgement count. votingMembers() includes witnesses, so they receive the hint and their acknowledgements count in both the read and commit quorums; the only sender kept from echoing a nonzero hint is an observer, which receives a heartbeat only with a zero context, and a sender outside every role map is dropped by the admission lookup.
